deployments_detail.use: Trend Vision One Companion: a generative-AI cybersecurity assistant embedded in the Vision One platform that helps SOC analysts investigate, analyze and respond to threats using natural-language queries and script/command explanation. [OpenAI GPT-3.5 (Azure OpenAI)]

Trend Cybertron: the industry's first specialized cybersecurity large language model plus an agentic framework for autonomous security agents, open-sourced and delivered as an NVIDIA NIM microservice for proactive risk prediction and attack-path analysis. [NVIDIA (Universal LLM NIM); Llama-based]
Writing Style DNA: AI that builds a model of an individual's email writing style to detect Business Email Compromise (BEC) impersonation and phishing in Trend Micro email security products.

Predictive Machine Learning / end-to-end deep learning malware detection engine used across Apex One, Deep Security, Cloud One Workload Security and Worry-Free to detect unknown and zero-day malware via file feature analysis.
Deepfake Detector / Deepfake Inspector: free AI tool that scans video calls in real time to alert users to AI face-swapping and deepfake impersonation scams, for consumers and enterprises.
Trend Micro ScamCheck: AI-powered consumer mobile app providing real-time scam detection across calls, SMS, websites and deepfake video calls, including a voice-enabled command to verify scams.

Trend Vision One Agentic SIEM: SIEM built on agentic AI where purpose-built autonomous agents act as SOC teammates, understanding logs in natural language to automate real-time detection and response.
"TrendAI" / "Trend Vision One" AI security platform (threat prediction/defense, 11 functions); Anthropic Claude integration for autonomous security ops

Trend Vision One with NVIDIA BlueField: hardware-enforced endpoint detection and response for agentic AI systems and AI factories, providing runtime protection of AI infrastructure. [NVIDIA BlueField DPU]

AI Application Security (Vision One AI Security Package): AI Scanner that continuously monitors AI models for vulnerabilities plus AI Guard that applies runtime guardrails to defend deployed AI applications.
Agentic SIEM and SOAR for security operations
Zero trust access control and GenAI prompt inspection
Enterprise AI Risk Management and AI Application Security
Enterprise AI Security Platform with NVIDIA integration [NVIDIA]
Trend Companion in the consumer Help Center: an AI assistant that answers customer questions about Trend Micro Home and Home Office products for self-service support.
AI-powered cybersecurity assistant for investigation and case management

Trend Micro built an internal agentic AI security assistant on Amazon Bedrock and Amazon Neptune, adding long-term and short-term agentic memory to power its security software. [AWS (Amazon Bedrock, Amazon Neptune)]
